product_wide_rationale: Governs when every worktree occupancy row releases, what a claim records at creation, where a session goes after terminal work, and what the audit reclaim limit bounds, across the agent surface, the durable authority, and the workflow engine, so no single runtime Domain owns it.
summary: A verified landing or a session_vacate releases every occupancy row of that session in any work item; a claim records the host process identity at creation; a row without identity releases when every live host lease started after its recorded_at and an unreadable lease set releases nothing; the adapter moves a session out of a terminal work item's worktree after complete, cancel, or supersede; and worktree_audit_reclaim classifies every drift row before its limit bounds reclaim attempts.
title: A worktree occupancy row releases when no live process predates it, and the reclaim limit counts attempts
